faq.q: Can I get vegan food on a yacht charter in Marbella?
faq.a: Yes, all our charters can be catered with plant-based menus. We work with local suppliers in Marbella and Estepona to provide vegan options including fresh salads, grilled vegetables, hummus, falafel, fruit platters, and dairy-free desserts. Just let us know at booking (48 hours minimum notice).

faq.q: What vegan dishes are typically available?
faq.a: Typical vegan catering includes Andalusian gazpacho, avocado toast, grilled artichokes, quinoa salads, vegetable paella, fresh tropical fruit, and almond-based desserts. We can also arrange sushi rolls, wraps, or tapas-style sharing platters. All menus are customised to your preference.

faq.q: Do you cater for other dietary restrictions?
faq.a: Absolutely. We accommodate gluten-free, nut-free, keto, halal, kosher, and other dietary needs alongside vegan options. Please specify all requirements at booking so we can coordinate with our caterers in Puerto Banús and Marbella.

faq.q: Which boats are best for a vegan charter?
faq.a: Any boat can be catered vegan. For large groups (12 pax), the Mangusta 80 (24m) or Ferretti 94 (29m) offer spacious decks for dining. For smaller parties, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) are excellent value at €749/2h.

faq.q: How much does a vegan yacht charter cost?
faq.a: Prices start at €749 for 2 hours on the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 (includes skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% IVA). The Mangusta 80 costs €4,719 for 4 hours (includes free jet ski). Other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp.

faq.q: Can we bring our own vegan food?
faq.a: Yes, you are welcome to bring your own food and drinks. However, our inclusive catering already covers soft drinks, water, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. If you want a full vegan meal, we recommend pre-ordering through us for convenience.

Our skippers are trained to accommodate all dietary needs. They can recommend vegan-friendly restaurants along the coast, such as spots in Puerto Banús, Cabopino, or Estepona. Just mention your preference when booking.

faq.q: What is the best time for a vegan yacht charter in 2035?
faq.a: The 2035 season runs April through October. June to September offers sea temperatures averaging 22–26°C and long sunny days. Book at least 2 weeks ahead for peak summer to secure your preferred boat and vegan menu.

data.body_html:
Planning a vegan catering yacht charter Marbella 2035 is easier than ever. Whether you're celebrating a birthday, hosting a corporate event, or simply enjoying the Costa del Sol, our fleet of 18 boats from Puerto Banús can be fully catered with plant-based menus. From the compact Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) to the luxurious Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax), every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% IVA. Prices start at €749 for 2 hours on the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39. Read on for everything you need to know about vegan catering on the water in 2035.

Why Choose a Vegan Yacht Charter in Marbella?

Marbella is a hub for health-conscious travellers. The local food scene — from organic markets in the Golden Mile to vegan-friendly restaurants in Puerto Banús — makes it easy to source fresh produce. On a yacht, you can enjoy a bespoke plant-based menu while anchored at Cala del Faro, Cala Cortés, or cruising past La Concha mountain. The 2035 season offers average sea temperatures of 22°C, ideal for swimming and sunbathing. Choosing vegan catering reduces your environmental footprint, aligning with sustainable tourism trends along the Andalusian coast.

Our Fleet: Which Boats Can Be Catered Vegan?

Every boat in our fleet supports vegan catering. Here are the most popular options:

  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) – €749/2h, ideal for small groups.
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – €749/2h, spacious for its size.
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) – €4,719/4h, includes free jet ski hire.
  • Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) – pricing on request, top-tier luxury.
  • Lagoon 380 (11.6m, 10 pax) – catamaran, stable platform for dining.

All depart from Puerto Banús. For larger groups, consider the Canados 86 (26m) or Maiora 26m (26m), both accommodating 12 pax. Contact us via WhatsApp for custom pricing on these boats.

Sample Vegan Menus for Your Charter

Our caterers in Marbella and Estepona create seasonal menus using local ingredients. Examples include:

  • Starter: Andalusian gazpacho with avocado croutons.
  • Main: Grilled artichokes with lemon-herb quinoa or vegetable paella.
  • Snacks: Hummus, falafel, olives, and fresh bread.
  • Desserts: Almond-based ‘cheesecake’ or tropical fruit platter.
  • Drinks: Included soft drinks, water, beer, white wine, and cava (vegan-friendly wines available on request).

Menus must be requested at least 48 hours before departure. We can also accommodate gluten-free, nut-free, or other restrictions alongside vegan.

How to Book a Vegan Charter in 2035

Booking is straightforward. Browse our fleet on our boat rental Marbella page, then contact us via WhatsApp with your preferred boat, date, and number of guests. Mention that you want vegan catering, and we’ll coordinate the menu. For the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, you can book directly online. For other boats, we’ll send a tailored quote. Peak season (June–September) fills quickly, so book at least two weeks ahead.

Best Spots for a Vegan Yacht Trip

From Puerto Banús, you can cruise to:

  • Cala del Faro – secluded cove near Marbella, perfect for swimming.
  • Cala Cortés – quiet beach with clear water, 15 minutes from port.
  • Cabopino – nature reserve with dunes and a vegan-friendly chiringuito.
  • Estepona – charming town with a marina and organic market.
  • Sotogrande – upscale area with gourmet vegan options.

Your skipper can recommend the best anchorages based on wind and sea conditions.

What’s Included in Every Charter

All our charters include:

  • Licensed skipper
  • Fuel
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (can be upgraded to full vegan menu)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%)

No hidden fees. You only pay for optional extras like jet ski hire (free on Mangusta 80), water toys, or premium catering.
